honors_and_awards.title: 1st Place at Penn Apps 2025 (Computer Vision Category)
honors_and_awards.description: Built a spatial interaction platform enabling 3D object manipulation with gesture tracking (MediaPipe + OpenCV) and real-time rendering. Integrated Gemini Live API to power “Jarvis,” an AI voice assistant providing context-aware design insights. Optimized for stability with Bézier motion smoothing, snap zones, and adaptive calibration.

honors_and_awards.title: HRT x CMU Hackathon 2nd Place Grand Prize Winner
honors_and_awards.description: 2nd place in 129 students to win the Hudson River Trading x Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science Hack 112 Competition. Built a project implementing a multiplayer game based on graph theory, leveraging layered recursion and backtracking techniques on a Breadth-First Search (BFS) algorithm to compute the most efficient/shortest path between a source actor and a target actor by nodal representation of shared communal appearances as edges in a graph.
